{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate by patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient is counted once
deduplicated_df = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count the number of unique patients
enrolled_patients = len(deduplicated_df)

# Print the result
print(enrolled_patients)"}
